statements.attributed: provides method for combinatorial solid-state chemistry of inorganic materials
statements.quote: The (FeCoNiMnCu)Pt films of 20 nm thickness were deposited onto thermally oxidized Si (100) substrates at room temperature in 2 mTorr Ar, by co‐sputtering of elemental Fe, Co, Ni, Mn, Cu, and Pt targets using 35, 30, 28, 20, 13, and 70 W power, respectively. Additional 20 nm (FeCoNiMnCu)Pt films were deposited onto Si/SiO2 by co‐sputtering of Pt with the composite FeCoNiMnCu target in 2 mTorr Ar at powers of 20 and 70 W, respectively.
